content:
The **Camo Ops Suit** is an Underarmor in *Fallout 76*.

This item is worn under armor and accepts mods from the Casual Underarmor Linings group.

| Lining | | | | | | | | | | | | 
| Name | Resistance | | | Effect | Description | Weight | Value | Resources | Requirements | Form ID | | 
| Standard Lining | – | – | – | – | Standard. | +10% | +10% | Ballistic Fiber x2 Cloth x4 | Known by default | 0016E990 | | 
| Treated Lining | +2 | +2 | +2 | – | – | +20% | +30% | Ballistic Fiber x4 Cloth x7 | Plan: Treated lining casual underarmor | 0016E984 | | 
| Resistant Lining | +3 | +3 | +3 | – | – | +30% | +50% | Ballistic Fiber x7 Cloth x11 | Plan: Resistant lining casual underarmor | 0016E97D | | 
| Protective Lining | +4 | +4 | +4 | – | – | +35% | +80% | Ballistic Fiber x9 Cloth x14 Stable Yellowcake Flux x2 | Plan: Protective lining casual underarmor | 0016E96C | | 
| Shielded Lining | +5 | +5 | +5 | – | – | +40% | +120% | Ballistic Fiber x11 Cloth x18 Stable Yellowcake Flux x4 | Plan: Shielded lining casual underarmor | 0016E962 | | 

The item is available from the Atomic Shop.
